Expected values are written independentl: Expected values are written independently, then every target is compiled and run. A missing compiler is blocked, not green.
Not a slogan, not a single universal run: Not a slogan, not a single universal runtime, and not a promise that every ecosystem behaves the same. h# defines one contract precisely enough that four different compiler toolchains can be checked against it.

Teams rewrite the same business rule for: Teams rewrite the same business rule for C#, Rust, Go, and Java. The syntax is different, but so are overflow behavior, evaluation order, error propagation, naming rules, and edge cases. The divergences appear later, in production.
